Messages.Author: David Edelstein
Messages.Body:
Question about Antediluvian Awakening:

Errata says a vampire can only be burned to burn AA during the
Methuselah's untap phase. Card text says each Methuselah burns 1 pool at
the start of his untap phase.

Does this mean that you cannot burn a vampire on your turn, during your
untap phase, before you lose 1 pool?

I know that usually you can take actions during a given phase in
whatever order you like. But I wasn't sure about this one, and the card
text suggests you can't, since "at the start of your untap phase"
doesn't seem to mean much if it's really "but after any other untap
actions you choose to take."

-David

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 26 Jun 2000, David Edelstein wrote:
> Errata says a vampire can only be burned to burn AA during the
> Methuselah's untap phase. Card text says each Methuselah burns 1 pool at
> the start of his untap phase.

Sionce the first thing that happens during your untap phase is untapping,
this text has been ruled (by general ruling) to mean "Takes place during
your untap phase".

>
> Does this mean that you cannot burn a vampire on your turn, during your
> untap phase, before you lose 1 pool?
>

No, you can order it either way round. (Burning the vampire aftferwards
might be usefl in order to pull off a Parity Shift, or to avoid one.)

> I know that usually you can take actions during a given phase in
> whatever order you like. But I wasn't sure about this one, and the card
> text suggests you can't, since "at the start of your untap phase"
> doesn't seem to mean much if it's really "but after any other untap
> actions you choose to take."

It means "After you have untapped all of your vampires, in any order
relative to other effects taking palce at the same time."

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
David Edelstein wrote:
>
> Question about Antediluvian Awakening:

>
> Errata says a vampire can only be burned to burn AA during the
> Methuselah's untap phase. Card text says each Methuselah burns 1 pool at
> the start of his untap phase.
>

> Does this mean that you cannot burn a vampire on your turn, during your
> untap phase, before you lose 1 pool?

No.

> I know that usually you can take actions during a given phase in
> whatever order you like. But I wasn't sure about this one, and the card
> text suggests you can't, since "at the start of your untap phase"
> doesn't seem to mean much if it's really "but after any other untap
> actions you choose to take."

"start of your untap phase" is not possible for effects - the only thing
that happens at the "start of your untap phase" is the untapping of all
of your cards. Other effects that occur during the untap phase can be
ordered as you wish [4].
